lines.2: If I wanted to celebrate with a clear conscience, I'd have to make it through today's interrogation at school in one piece.
lines.4: Instead of the director's office, we had been summoned to the dojo.
lines.5: 「I thought we might discuss matters more calmly here.」
lines.7: 「You know why you were summoned, I take it? A concern has been raised that a young couple living under one roof may be... unhealthy.」
lines.8: 「For a school to raise that concern is only natural.」
lines.9: 「We appreciate you doing your duty, Director.」
lines.10: 「Indeed. Personally, I have no complaints so long as you both do what is expected of you. Of course, that is the difficult part.」
lines.11: 「The concern, Kurogane, is that you are a member of the disciplinary committee. Some believe this sets a poor example.」
lines.12: 「We are relatives, and we have our parents' permission. Is there still a problem?」
lines.13: 「Your grades are excellent, Kurogane, and you have brought the martial arts club considerable distinction.」
lines.14: 「And we haven't done anything indecent in public at school.」
lines.16: But if nobody caught us, there wasn't a problem.
lines.17: 「Indeed. Good conduct in daily life serves you well at times like these.」
lines.18: 「And this is not some game to us. We are entirely serious.」
lines.24: 「...You won't find many young women willing to say it so plainly.」
lines.26: 「It helps that you have not been openly carrying on and that Kurogane's grades are excellent.」
lines.27: 「You are relatives, after all. If you both take proper care from now on, I see no reason not to permit it.」
lines.28: 「On one condition: your grades must not fall.」
lines.30: 「Think of this not as a judgment, but as a warning to keep it from becoming a problem.」
lines.34: 「Good. Continue to treat one another well.」
lines.37: 「...And no sooner does he say it than we're holding hands.」
lines.38: 「If schools tried to stop students from even holding hands these days, everybody would revolt.」
lines.39: 「True. This must be the line, then.」
lines.42: 「I was wondering if kissing at school would be too risky now.」
lines.43: 「I'll do my very best to hold back, so you do the same... difficult though it may be.」
lines.45: 「We'll just make up for it with plenty of affection at home.」
lines.46: 「Th-that's exactly the kind of improper thing you shouldn't say.」
lines.49: 「I-I told you not to say such things here...」
lines.50: 「You don't have to say anything. At times like this, just squeeze my hand.」
lines.57: 「School rules matter, but above all, I abide by the rules I set for myself.」
lines.58: 「It is my life, and no one else's.」
lines.63: 「Looks like you're never gonna stop being a coward.」
lines.64: 「I take such good care of you, but you're still a troublesome little nag.」
lines.68: 「You're the kind of boy who needs somebody to look after him.」
lines.69: 「So I'll take you as my bride... got it?」
lines.72: 「(I don't really get what she means, but she's scary, so I'll just say yes.)」
lines.78: 「It was the 'I've decided!' that jogged my memory.」
lines.79: 「For my part, until you and I ended up together, I remembered it only vaguely. I had no particular intention of keeping that promise...」
lines.80: 「Yet this is where we ended up.」
lines.81: 「Yep. And we all lived happily ever after.」
lines.82: 「So please, take me as your bride.」
lines.83: 「D-don't tease me. You have that backward.」
lines.84: 「Hey, you're the one who said it.」
lines.87: Violence whenever things got inconvenient. Typical.
lines.88: 「Damn it, I'm getting out of here!」
lines.90: 「Two shadows old enough to know better, romping in the sunset.」
lines.91: 「If that's how innocently they carry on, even the school would feel silly punishing them.」
lines.92: 「Watching them like this, they look less like lovers and more like...」
